Q4.notes: Bank renamed to Standard Islami Bank PLC effective 10-Feb-2026 (full Islamic conversion). 27th AGM (30-Jul-2026) approved FY2025 financials but no annual report PDF published yet; dsebd.org shows only headline EPS/NAV/profit with no balance sheet. Not a permanent gap like the Sammilito-merger banks - just not yet published; worth re-checking in a future session.

Core balance sheet/P&L/capital from the audited Financial Statements (97pp scanned PDF, OCR'd via tesseract, cross-validated against the auditor's own prose narrative independently - both reconcile exactly). The real Annual Report PDF was unreachable (connection refused); EPS/NAV/market price came from supplementary sources (DSE price archive, PSI notice) since the audited FS doesn't disclose them. Qualified audit opinion: without BB-forborne provisioning, CRAR would be 0.93% vs reported 8.42%. ldr_pct here is a simple gross-loans/deposits calc, NOT comparable to the bank's own regulatory ratio used in 2011-2024 (confirmed non-equivalent).

Confirmed unavailable 2026-08-26: Union Bank was declared non-viable (Bank Resolution Ordinance 2025 Sec 15) effective 5-Nov-2025, trading suspended same day, merged into the newly formed state-owned Sammilito Islami Bank PLC together with EXIM Bank, First Security Islami Bank, Global Islami Bank, and Social Islami Bank under Bangladesh Bank resolution of S Alam Group-linked banks (Advisory Council approved the merger 9-Oct-2025, before FY2025 even closed). Permanent series-end, not a reporting lag. This is the 5th and final bank of that merger group now accounted for in this dataset.
